No class-diagram skill was available, so I built this by hand from the production sources. I left out test sources, plus the `microbench` benchmarks and the `transport-native-unix-common-tests` module, because neither is production code. The anonymous no-op implementation inside `PlatformDependent` is shown as `PlatformDependent_NOOP_Buffer`.

```mermaid
classDiagram
    direction LR

    class CleanableDirectBuffer {
        <<interface>>
        +buffer() ByteBuffer
        +clean() void
        +hasMemoryAddress() boolean
        +memoryAddress() long
    }
    class ByteBuffer {
        <<java.nio>>
    }
    CleanableDirectBuffer ..> ByteBuffer : returns

    %% ===== Cleaner SPI (io.netty.util.internal) =====
    class Cleaner {
        <<interface>>
        +allocate(int capacity) CleanableDirectBuffer
        +reallocate(CleanableDirectBuffer old, int newCapacity) CleanableDirectBuffer
    }
    class CleanerJava6
    class CleanerJava9
    class CleanerJava25
    class CleanerJava24Linker
    class DirectCleaner
    class PlatformDependent {
        +allocateDirect(int) CleanableDirectBuffer$
        +allocateDirect(int, boolean) CleanableDirectBuffer$
        +reallocateDirect(CleanableDirectBuffer, int) CleanableDirectBuffer$
    }

    Cleaner ..> CleanableDirectBuffer : creates
    CleanerJava6 ..|> Cleaner
    CleanerJava9 ..|> Cleaner
    CleanerJava25 ..|> Cleaner
    CleanerJava24Linker ..|> Cleaner
    DirectCleaner ..|> Cleaner
    PlatformDependent ..> Cleaner : uses
    PlatformDependent ..> CleanableDirectBuffer : allocates

    %% ===== Implementations of CleanableDirectBuffer =====
    class CleanerJava6_CleanableDirectBufferImpl
    class CleanerJava9_CleanableDirectBufferImpl
    class CleanerJava25_CleanableDirectBufferImpl
    class CleanerJava24Linker_CleanableDirectBufferImpl
    class DirectCleaner_CleanableDirectBufferImpl
    class PlatformDependent_NOOP_Buffer {
        <<anonymous>>
    }
    class DecrementingCleanableDirectBuffer {
        -UnpooledByteBufAllocator alloc
        -CleanableDirectBuffer delegate
    }

    CleanerJava6_CleanableDirectBufferImpl ..|> CleanableDirectBuffer
    CleanerJava9_CleanableDirectBufferImpl ..|> CleanableDirectBuffer
    CleanerJava25_CleanableDirectBufferImpl ..|> CleanableDirectBuffer
    CleanerJava24Linker_CleanableDirectBufferImpl ..|> CleanableDirectBuffer
    DirectCleaner_CleanableDirectBufferImpl ..|> CleanableDirectBuffer
    PlatformDependent_NOOP_Buffer ..|> CleanableDirectBuffer
    DecrementingCleanableDirectBuffer ..|> CleanableDirectBuffer
    DecrementingCleanableDirectBuffer o-- CleanableDirectBuffer : delegate

    CleanerJava6 *-- CleanerJava6_CleanableDirectBufferImpl
    CleanerJava9 *-- CleanerJava9_CleanableDirectBufferImpl
    CleanerJava25 *-- CleanerJava25_CleanableDirectBufferImpl
    CleanerJava24Linker *-- CleanerJava24Linker_CleanableDirectBufferImpl
    DirectCleaner *-- DirectCleaner_CleanableDirectBufferImpl
    PlatformDependent *-- PlatformDependent_NOOP_Buffer

    %% ===== buffer module (io.netty.buffer) =====
    class UnpooledDirectByteBuf {
        ~CleanableDirectBuffer cleanable
        #allocateDirectBuffer(int) CleanableDirectBuffer
        ~setByteBuffer(CleanableDirectBuffer, boolean) void
    }
    class UnpooledUnsafeDirectByteBuf {
        ~setByteBuffer(CleanableDirectBuffer, boolean) void
    }
    class UnpooledUnsafeNoCleanerDirectByteBuf {
        ~reallocateDirect(CleanableDirectBuffer, int) CleanableDirectBuffer
    }
    class UnpooledByteBufAllocator
    class InstrumentedUnpooledDirectByteBuf
    class InstrumentedUnpooledUnsafeDirectByteBuf
    class InstrumentedUnpooledUnsafeNoCleanerDirectByteBuf
    class PoolArena~T~ {
        <<abstract>>
    }
    class DirectArena {
        -allocateDirect(int) CleanableDirectBuffer$
    }
    class PoolChunk~T~ {
        ~CleanableDirectBuffer cleanable
    }

    UnpooledUnsafeDirectByteBuf --|> UnpooledDirectByteBuf
    UnpooledUnsafeNoCleanerDirectByteBuf --|> UnpooledUnsafeDirectByteBuf
    InstrumentedUnpooledDirectByteBuf --|> UnpooledDirectByteBuf
    InstrumentedUnpooledUnsafeDirectByteBuf --|> UnpooledUnsafeDirectByteBuf
    InstrumentedUnpooledUnsafeNoCleanerDirectByteBuf --|> UnpooledUnsafeNoCleanerDirectByteBuf
    DirectArena --|> PoolArena~T~

    UnpooledDirectByteBuf o-- CleanableDirectBuffer : cleanable
    UnpooledUnsafeDirectByteBuf ..> CleanableDirectBuffer
    UnpooledUnsafeNoCleanerDirectByteBuf ..> CleanableDirectBuffer
    InstrumentedUnpooledDirectByteBuf ..> DecrementingCleanableDirectBuffer : creates
    InstrumentedUnpooledUnsafeDirectByteBuf ..> DecrementingCleanableDirectBuffer : creates
    InstrumentedUnpooledUnsafeNoCleanerDirectByteBuf ..> DecrementingCleanableDirectBuffer : creates
    UnpooledByteBufAllocator *-- DecrementingCleanableDirectBuffer
    UnpooledByteBufAllocator *-- InstrumentedUnpooledDirectByteBuf
    UnpooledByteBufAllocator *-- InstrumentedUnpooledUnsafeDirectByteBuf
    UnpooledByteBufAllocator *-- InstrumentedUnpooledUnsafeNoCleanerDirectByteBuf
    DecrementingCleanableDirectBuffer --> UnpooledByteBufAllocator : alloc
    DirectArena ..> CleanableDirectBuffer : allocates
    DirectArena ..> PoolChunk~T~ : creates
    PoolChunk~T~ o-- CleanableDirectBuffer : cleanable

    %% ===== transport-native-unix-common (io.netty.channel.unix) =====
    class Buffer {
        +allocateDirectBufferWithNativeOrder(int) CleanableDirectBuffer$
    }
    class IovArray {
        -CleanableDirectBuffer cleanable
    }
    Buffer ..> CleanableDirectBuffer : allocates
    Buffer ..> PlatformDependent : uses
    IovArray o-- CleanableDirectBuffer

    %% ===== epoll =====
    class EpollEventArray {
        -CleanableDirectBuffer cleanable
    }
    EpollEventArray o-- CleanableDirectBuffer
    EpollEventArray ..> Buffer

    %% ===== kqueue =====
    class KQueueEventArray {
        -CleanableDirectBuffer memoryCleanable
    }
    class NativeLongArray {
        -CleanableDirectBuffer memoryCleanable
    }
    KQueueEventArray o-- CleanableDirectBuffer
    NativeLongArray o-- CleanableDirectBuffer
    KQueueEventArray ..> Buffer
    NativeLongArray ..> Buffer

    %% ===== io_uring (io.netty.channel.uring) =====
    class AbstractIoUringChannel {
        <<abstract>>
        -CleanableDirectBuffer cleanable
    }
    class AbstractIoUringServerChannel {
        <<abstract>>
    }
    class AcceptedAddressMemory {
        -CleanableDirectBuffer acceptedAddressMemoryCleanable
        -CleanableDirectBuffer acceptedAddressLengthMemoryCleanable
    }
    class IoUringIoHandler {
        -CleanableDirectBuffer eventfdReadBufCleanable
        -CleanableDirectBuffer timeoutMemoryCleanable
    }
    class IoUringSharedIovArray {
        -CleanableDirectBuffer cleanable
    }
    class MsgHdrMemory {
        -CleanableDirectBuffer msgHdrMemoryCleanable
        -CleanableDirectBuffer socketAddrMemoryCleanable
        -CleanableDirectBuffer iovMemoryCleanable
        -CleanableDirectBuffer cmsgDataMemoryCleanable
    }
    class MsgHdrMemoryArray {
        -CleanableDirectBuffer msgHdrMemoryArrayMemoryCleanable
    }

    AbstractIoUringServerChannel --|> AbstractIoUringChannel
    AbstractIoUringServerChannel *-- AcceptedAddressMemory
    AbstractIoUringChannel o-- CleanableDirectBuffer
    AcceptedAddressMemory o-- CleanableDirectBuffer
    IoUringIoHandler o-- CleanableDirectBuffer
    IoUringSharedIovArray o-- CleanableDirectBuffer
    MsgHdrMemory o-- CleanableDirectBuffer
    MsgHdrMemoryArray o-- CleanableDirectBuffer
```
